$comment: Checked classification of the production-only invocation audit that first exposed 242 tools on 2026-09-01.
Every original finding appears exactly once in categories; tools discovered or created after the first capture are included as current-only.
customer-runtime-intended is NOT an exclusion: each current file in that class remains a release-blocking missing production path.
build-release and developer-only are truthful non-customer classes, not claims of production reachability.
retired-stale files must remain absent and all package/payload/integrity/test references must be removed.
Reachability evidence is explicit below: every current finding has no production chain; testExpandedOnly distinguishes test laundering from files not reached even when tests expand.
tools/measure-tree-courier-tick.js is a manually invoked scratch-state timing experiment, not a customer-runtime mechanism; its developer-only classification grants no invocation path.
The 2026-09-05 reconciliation restores the two historical findings removed by fe640324f6b882aa12b75333c1c5029d3bda7f1e; their absent programs are retired-stale, not erased from original242.
Current evidence was recomputed from the declared invocation graph after adding the externally invoked npm:test:strict release root; capturedAt continues to identify the original audit.

2026-09-07: tools/check-capability-mirror.js added (R70, engine-side capability-mirror check). Classified developer-only / manual / notReachedEvenWithTests: a release operator runs it against a separately checked-out app repository, and its dedicated test (tests/check-capability-mirror.test.js) is not itself wired into pretest/test, matching the existing tools/build-queue-migrate.js precedent.
2026-09-08 combined integration: current evidence recomputed after wiring the structured effort fixture; original242 and declared classifications remain unchanged.
2026-09-08 final C5/C6 reconciliation: retained C5 wiring and manual classifications; added the two real health-observer edges from C6, then recomputed current evidence.

2026-09-08 Precut apparatus readiness: classified the three builtin assertion measurement helpers as build-release and recomputed current evidence after wiring both regression tests through the normal pretest repository-protocol command. No registry exemptions or customer runtime edges were added.

2026-09-21: classified the five tools the 1.0.45 cut added. build-release: tools/provider-runtimes/gemini-quota/build.mjs is the reviewed esbuild recipe a maintainer runs (npm run build:gemini-quota-runtime, which is not a declared root) to produce the committed provider-runtimes/gemini-quota payload whose digests config/gemini-quota-runtime.json pins, and tools/provider-runtimes/gemini-quota/bundle-entry.mjs is that recipe's bundler entry module -- production loads the compiled provider-runtimes/gemini-quota/sdk.mjs from src/lib/providers/gemini-quota-worker.mjs, never the recipe or its entry. developer-only: tools/t31-walk.js is a hand-run scenario walk that refuses to start without an explicit --scratch-root, tools/t58-native-ui-handtest.js spawns one real hidden-console owner-prompt dialog for a human to look at, and tools/vault-access-redgreen.mjs is the hand-run mutation check for tests/vault-access-policy-enforced.test.js. None of the five gained an invocation path and no registry exemption was added.

classificationBasis.build-release: Installer migrations, integrity repinning, test parity, package and cut checks, and release-only registrars are invoked only by maintainers or release automation; classification does not create a customer runtime edge.
classificationBasis.developer-only: Manual diagnostics, historical migrations, operator smokes, report and query helpers, and superseded CLI wrappers have no shipped automatic customer lifecycle; their product implementations, where any, are separate reachable modules.
classificationBasis.customer-runtime-intended: Current files in this class remain blockers unless a real shipped app, MCP, installer, client-hook, or managed-process entry reaches them. Package or payload membership alone is not an invocation root.
classificationBasis.retired-stale: These deleted mechanisms were superseded or explicitly disabled; absence is enforced and no package, payload, integrity, service, or suite reference may revive them.

customerReclassificationFindings.tools/agent-sweep-task.ps1: No installer, managed-process, client-hook, or app path registers this recovery task; it is a dormant scheduled-task prototype.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/agent-sweep.js: Only the unregistered sweep task or manual CLI names it; shipped agent lifecycle has no caller.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/agent-wake.js: The wake CLI and lane-run recovery chain have no installed registrar or app/MCP root.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/apply-startup-policy.ps1: Standalone policy-maintenance helper; install and app startup do not invoke it.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/audit-durability-check.js: Diagnostic promise has no installed health-observer registrar or app lifecycle caller.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/collect-process-visibility.ps1: Collector has no installation registration and the visibility refresh path cannot provision its required UAC operation.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/owner-capture-reconcile.js: WAL reconciler has no app wake, managed process, scheduler, or installer binding.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/owner-chat.js: Pending-on-every-wake claim has no wake lifecycle caller in the shipped product.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/peer-dispatch.js: Exact-two generic CLI is safe but has no shipped UI, MCP, bin, hook, or managed-process entry.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/process-visibility-refresh.js: No installed observer lifecycle reaches refresh; its required UAC allowlist operation is absent.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/process-visibility-snapshot-writer: Writer is only downstream of the unregistered visibility collector/refresh chain.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/repo-sync-task.ps1: Registrar expects a missing managed-process repo-sync declaration and deterministically throws.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/repo-sync.js: Unattended-receiver claim has no install, app-start, managed-process, or scheduler root.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/resource-alerts-task.ps1: Scheduled-task registrar is not invoked by install or the app.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/resource-alerts.js: Resource observer has no manifest/installer/app lifecycle root except its unregistered task template.
customerReclassificationFindings.tools/settings-set.js: Claims the only settings write path but has no UI, MCP, app, bin, or installer caller.

refresh.reason: Restored the immutable original finding after two helpers were removed; classified the explicit scratch profiler and recorded the real vault-worker subprocess edge.

linuxIncrement.reason: Explicit paired-process diagnostic uses fresh memory-only identities over pinned SSH; it does not enroll a device or admit workspace actions. The executing Linux native test and root test suite invoke its local two-process driver. No customer runtime exemption was added.

builtinAssertionIncrement.testInvocation: npm test -> pretest -> npm run test:repo-protocol -> tests/run-isolated.js (both builtin assertion regression files as direct argv)

findings.tools/lib/builtin-assertion-evidence.js: Assertion instrumentation and raw-trace validation used by the measurement launcher, scope helper and regression tests; it has no customer runtime caller.
findings.tools/lib/builtin-assertion-scope.js: Reviewed-scope preparation and evidence retention used only by the isolated test runner with explicit strict assertion measurement; it is a library, not a manual entrypoint.
findings.tools/measure-builtin-assertions.js: Child launcher executes a reviewed test from an explicit request created by the isolated test runner or bounded fixtures; it is test and release evidence tooling, not a customer lifecycle mechanism.
